error.notPlant: This photo doesn't show a plant, so it wasn't analysed. Take a close, well-lit photo of the plant's leaves, stem or fruit and try again.

error.network: Can't reach the Crop Advisor server. Check your internet connection and try again.

home.scanText: Take a photo or drop one here. AI checks its health, problems, growth stage, fertilizer needs and harvest readiness.
home.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Yellow leaves with brown rings on the lower branches after a week of rain
home.chooseFirst: Choose a photo above to start.
home.recentEmpty: Your plant analyses will appear here.
home.photoTip: Photo tip: shoot in daylight, fill the frame with the affected leaves or fruit, and add a short description of what you see.
home.step1: Checking the photo shows a plant…
home.step2: Looking for disease and pest signs…
analysis.deleteConfirm: Delete this analysis and its photo?
analysis.expertTitle: Confirm with an expert before you spray or buy anything
analysis.expertNote: Show this report to your local extension officer or an agronomist. Use the print button to save it as a PDF.
expert.severe: A serious problem was found that can spread or cause heavy losses.
expert.unsure_problem: The AI is not sure what the problem is.
expert.unsure_crop: The AI is not sure which crop this is, so the advice may not fit.
expert.offline: This is an estimate from leaf colour only; the AI model was not available.
analysis.noIssues: No diseases, pests or deficiencies detected. Keep up the good work!
analysis.treatmentIntro: Based on the identified issue, here's a guide to help you treat your crop:
analysis.noTreatment: Your plant looks healthy — no treatment needed. Follow the prevention tips to keep it that way.
analysis.safety: Use only crop-protection products registered for your crop in your country. Follow the label, wear protective gear and respect the pre-harvest interval. Confirm serious cases with your local extension officer.
analysis.disclaimer: AI suggestions support, but don't replace, advice from your local extension officer.
chat.welcome: Hello! I'm your Crop Advisor AI Assistant. I can help with plant disease identification, nutrient management, watering advice, and crop care recommendations. How can I assist you today?
chat.title: Crop Advisor AI Assistant
chat.ex1: Why are my tomato leaves turning yellow?
chat.ex2: How often should I water these plants?
chat.ex3: What can I do about these spots on my leaves?
chat.ex4: Are my tomatoes ready for harvesting?
chat.ex5: How can I improve my crop production?
chat.ex6: How do I treat tomato blight?
chat.photoQuestion: Please look at this photo of my plant. What do you see and what should I do?
chat.scanContext: The assistant uses this scan's diagnosis when answering.
chat.photoAttached: Photo attached — ask a question or just send.
